hero.title: Data Converter.
hero.subtitle: Convert data instantly between multiple developer and data formats including JSON, XML, CSV, Base64, HEX, URL encoding, and more with a secure browser-based converter.

items.a: Yes. All processing happens locally in your browser. Your data is never sent to any server. This makes SafeTools ideal for processing sensitive API responses, config files, or proprietary data structures.
We currently support JSON, CSV, XML, Base64, HEX, and URL encoding/decoding. We are constantly expanding our matrix to include more developer-centric formats.

items.q: Can I use this for large datasets?
items.a: Yes. Our engine is optimized for performance. However, because it runs entirely in your browser's memory, the maximum file size depends on your device's available RAM.

items.q: Does it support nested JSON to CSV?
items.a: Currently, the JSON-to-CSV converter handles flat arrays of objects. For deeply nested structures, we recommend flattening your data before conversion for optimal results.
SafeTools is built on open standards. Our logic uses standard browser APIs and WASM-optimized libraries to ensure transparency and security.
